stem.text: Which statement concerning the hydrolysis of 1-bromopropane with water is correct?

A.text: The hydrolysis reaction between water and 1-iodopropane is faster because the C–Br bond is less polar than the C–I bond.

B.text: The hydrolysis reaction with water is very slow because water is a weak electrophile.

C.text: The mechanism of the reaction involves the formation of a stable carbocation.

D.text: The reaction is slower with 1-chloropropane because the C–Cl bond is stronger than the C–Br bond.
